text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 31 trucks loaded with food bought under oil-for-food deal with U.N. arrive in Iraq.
- Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan, Prime Minister Majali receive Iraq's Deputy Prime Minister Aziz.
- Aziz says future will see improving Iraqi-Jordanian ties.
- U.N. sanctions committee ratifies contracts for food bought by Iraq from Jordan under oil pact.
- National Assembly discusses improving financial status of doctors.
- Vietnamese prime minister says his country will continue providing Iraq with rice.
- Russian deputy foreign minister says end of year will be beginning of lifting all sanctions on Iraq.
(The above stories, except the last two, were carried by JUMHOURIYA and THAWRA)
- Letter from speaker of National Assembly to Qatari counterpart on prospects for oil cooperation.
- Eldest son of President Saddam Hussein, Uday, receives former Syrian president Amin al-Hafez.
